content:
1. A reflection across line \(l\) must lie on the perpendicular from \(P\) to \(l\), on the opposite side of \(l\), at the same distance from \(l\) as \(P\).
2. From the diagram, the line through \(P\) perpendicular to \(l\) passes through point \(A\).
3. The midpoint of \(\overline{PA}\) lies on line \(l\), and \(P\) and \(A\) are equidistant from \(l\), so \(A\) is the reflection of \(P\).

\[
\boxed{\text{A: Point A}}
\]

(Equivalently, \(\boxed{A}\).)
